questions.question: 1. What is the purpose of back up protection?

answers.d: To guard against failure of primary

explanations.a: Incorrect. Backup protection is not for increasing speed.
explanations.b: Incorrect. Reach is not the primary purpose.
explanations.c: Incorrect. Blind spots are addressed by primary protection design.
explanations.d: Correct. Backup protection operates when primary protection fails to clear a fault.

questions.question: 2. What is the actuating quantity for the relays?

explanations.a: Partial. Relays can respond to magnitude (overcurrent, undervoltage).
explanations.b: Partial. Frequency relays respond to frequency deviations.
explanations.c: Partial. Directional relays respond to phase angle.
explanations.d: Correct. Relays can be actuated by magnitude, frequency, phase angle, or combinations thereof.

questions.question: 3. The Induction Motor failures are mainly due to:

explanations.a: Partial. Electrical faults (stator winding, rotor bars) are a major cause.
explanations.b: Partial. Mechanical stresses (bearing failure, shaft misalignment) are common.
explanations.c: Partial. Environmental conditions (moisture, dust, temperature) contribute to failures.
explanations.d: Correct. Induction motor failures can result from electrical, mechanical, and environmental factors.

questions.question: 4. What are the protections in starter of 3-phase induction motor:

explanations.a: Partial. Starters limit inrush current (e.g., star-delta, auto-transformer).
explanations.b: Partial. Overload relays protect against prolonged overcurrent.
explanations.c: Partial. No-voltage/under-voltage protection prevents restart after power failure.
explanations.d: Correct. Starters typically include starting current limitation, overload protection, and no-voltage protection.

questions.question: 5. Name the protection used for induction motor from overload, single phasing, locked rotor and earth fault:

explanations.a: Incorrect. Fuses only provide short-circuit protection, not overload or single phasing.
explanations.b: Correct. Numerical (digital) relays like MPR 300 provide comprehensive protection including overload, single phasing, locked rotor, and earth fault.
explanations.c: Incorrect. Basic starter protection (thermal overload) may not cover all these faults.
explanations.d: Incorrect because numerical protection does provide these functions.
